note: Animations drawn in code for the Real Madrid in Athens film: plain shirts, no marks, no real person.

pieces.description: Athens at night: the Acropolis lit on its rock, the city below, floodlights in the distance; the camera drifts in
Four plain shirts drop onto a rail one by one: Real Madrid white, Olympiacos red-and-white stripes, Panathinaikos green, AEK yellow and black, each with its name tag
A ground at night in red and white, flares in the stand, two lines of players walk out, white and red; tag PIRAEUS
A ground at night in green and white, flares in the stand, white and green players walk out; tag ATHENS
A ground at night in yellow and black, flares in the stand, white and yellow players walk out; tag ATHENS
